VAR-weight.why: Household-level sampling weight variable explicitly labeled Household weight.

VAR-year.why: Household file has Year of the survey (constant 2024), plausible source for survey start year.
Person file also carries Year of the survey; may be used if year is sourced from person table.
Register/person roster file also carries Year of the survey; alternative source depending on binding table.

VAR-intyear.why: No separate interview-date fields found; Year of the survey may be used as interview year if fieldwork is within one year.
Person file duplicate of Year of the survey; candidate if intyear is read from person table.
Roster file duplicate of Year of the survey; candidate if intyear is read from roster table.

VAR-intmonth.why: No obvious interview month / interview date variable in the bindable tables; may be held only in metadata, not delivered as a column.

VAR-countrycode.why: No country/ISO code column found in the delivered tables; countrycode likely needs to be authored as a constant from survey identity (Turkey/ISO3) rather than extracted from data.
